# qmd

A local hybrid search engine for markdown vaults — BM25 keyword scoring plus on-device vector similarity, exposed as a CLI and MCP server.

## Claims
- Observed (2026-04-22): combines BM25 + on-device vectors, runs fully local. [[wiki/sources/qmd-readme]]
- Observed (2026-04-22): designed as the off-ramp from index-first retrieval at scale. [[wiki/sources/qmd-readme]]
